history.note: live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend).

4.2.6-rs-m5.label: borg-rs M5 (tag 4.2.6-impact-v5): the Rust Borg carrying better-borg-c milestone 5's fixes (5384f12e; borg-rs#13, PR 14; qualified pass, owner accepted). The engine is unchanged since 4.2.6-impact-v4, so its game still differs from better-borg-c M5 by that tag's engine correction (neo-angband-tracker#474).

4.2.6-rs-m6.label: borg-rs M6 (tag 4.2.6-impact-v6): the Rust Borg carrying better-borg-c milestone 6's fixes (b3c825c9; borg-rs#15, PR 16; qualified pass, owner accepted). 4.2.6-rs-m6-c.label: borg-rs 4.2.6-impact-v6, C Borg: the C Borg in borg-rs's tree with better-borg-c milestone 6's fixes, under the borgh frontend. The engine is unchanged since 4.2.6-impact-v4, so it keeps that tag's engine correction (neo-angband-tracker#474).
